title: Biryani Salmon
description: A fusion of Indian flavors and salmon, creating a unique and delicious dish.
instructions: Season the salmon fillets with salt, cumin, coriander, turmeric, red chili powder, and garam masala.
Heat 1 tablespoon of ghee or oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the salmon fillets, skin side up, and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Flip the salmon over and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the salmon is cooking, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of ghee or oil in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add the biryani rice and cook, stirring constantly, until lightly toasted.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked.
To serve, place a salmon fillet on each plate and top with a portion of the biryani rice.
Garnish with crispy fried onions or chopped cilantro, if desired.
